Today’s Keating work was substantial. Three changes were committed; most newer features remain uncommitted in the shared worktree.

## Committed work

1. **Keating 2.10.0 — `82479ac`**

   - Improved model-search layout.
   - Fixed Hyperframes scaling and diagnostics.
   - Added explicit tool contracts and visible failure reporting.
   - Lazy-loaded NodePod/Lix.
   - Consolidated commands into devenv tasks.
   - Tagged and pushed `v2.10.0`; GitHub Release completion was not confirmed at the recorded boundary.

2. **Production subscription OAuth — `2d7738b`**

   - Claude Pro/Max and ChatGPT Plus/Pro authorization flows.
   - GitHub Copilot device authorization and refresh.
   - Nitro/browser dependency separation.
   - Reported production deployment and 601 passing web tests.

3. **Recoverable OAuth handoffs — `5067f59`**

   - Pending sign-ins survive reloads.
   - Resume/cancel UI for authorization-code and GitHub device flows.
   - Reported 604 passing tests and successful deployment.
   - Full OpenAI model E2E remained blocked by account phone verification.

## Implemented but uncommitted

- **Context-aware model picker**

  [ModelSelector.tsx](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/web/src/components/ModelSelector.tsx) now has multi-provider and multi-capability selection, ≥256k long-context filtering, image-only retry selection, and separate TTS/realtime-audio lanes. Storybook and rendered checks were recorded; 596 tests passed with one OAuth assertion that was subsequently addressed.

- **Coming Up and Anki**

  [ComingUp.tsx](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/web/src/pages/ComingUp.tsx) adds Focus/Maintain/Low lanes, due-review protection, topic/check/deck aggregation, inline review, and native `.apkg` plus CSV/TSV import. The implementation reported 617 passing tests and browser validation.

  A later review found unresolved integration concerns: missing call sites, weak merge/storage coverage, orphaned priorities, incorrect aggregate time, untrimmed identifiers, duplicated SRS logic, and questionable `nextDueAt` semantics.

- **Live audio/video inside chat**

  [AssistantChatPanel.tsx](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/web/src/components/AssistantChatPanel.tsx) gained an in-chat Live mode with camera/screen preview, transcript persistence, error states, dictation fallback, and mobile handling. It reported 617 tests and successful builds, but no genuine provider-backed media session was exercised.

- **Courses and multi-user learning**

  A large uncommitted implementation now exists around [contracts.ts](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/web/src/courses/contracts.ts):

  - Owner, teacher, student, and peer roles.
  - Teacher-access consent.
  - Durable course repository and optimistic revisions.
  - Invitations and Not Organic account gating.
  - Course pages and collaboration UI.
  - Realtime presence and authenticated operations.
  - Server-side Pear/Hypercore mirror.
  - Course operation tests.

  This passed through several authorization/privacy reviews, but there is no trustworthy final integrated-validation result in the preserved thread. It should be treated as unfinished.

- **Standard.site/ATProto blog**

  [AtprotoBlog.tsx](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/web/src/pages/AtprotoBlog.tsx) adds PDS-backed publication/document records, Markpub Markdown, canonical metadata, well-known discovery, and a migration publisher for 46 legacy posts. It reported 634 passing tests, builds, mock-PDS verification, and browser rendering. Live Tranquil publication remains blocked on account credentials.

- **Landing-page screencasts**

  [SurfaceScreencasts.tsx](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/web/src/components/SurfaceScreencasts.tsx) provides accessible Web/CLI/TUI switching. That component and the Landing integration are staged; the tapes, videos, and posters remain untracked. The final focused code audit returned no issues.

## Other concurrent work

- Devenv tasks were renamed under the `keating:` namespace and documentation was updated.
- The missing devenv `git-hooks` input was added.
- An Atuin `.bashrc` patch attempt appears incomplete and left an empty `atuin` file plus `history.txt`; those look accidental.

## Current repository state

`main` is at `5067f59` and aligned with `origin/main`, but the worktree contains:

- 25 modified tracked files.
- Two staged screencast files.
- Numerous untracked Courses, Coming Up, blog, video, and test files.

So the work is preserved, but much of today’s product work is not yet protected by commits. The recorded test results above come from the individual Codex sessions; I did not rerun the combined dirty tree today.

Implemented the bounded OpenTUI learning cockpit slice.

Changed files:

- [view-model.ts](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/src/tui/view-model.ts:3): typed transcript entries, session/header/activity models, history hydration, error redaction, responsive rail policy, command definitions.
- [host-controller.ts](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/src/tui/host-controller.ts:94): RPC history/state hydration, model/thinking/session/abort controls, typed events, visible sanitized tool failures.
- [opentui-host.ts](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/src/tui/opentui-host.ts:70): responsive transcript/activity layout, stateful header, command palette, shortcuts, slash aliases, draft-safe dialogs.
- [opentui-host.test.ts](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/test/opentui-host.test.ts:75): controller hydration/control/failure coverage.
- [tui-view-model.test.ts](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/test/tui-view-model.test.ts:14): view-model hydration, sanitization, header, and responsive behavior coverage.

Delivered:

- Existing RPC messages hydrate into user, assistant, tool, artifact, notice, and error entries.
- Tool failures are visible and redact API keys, tokens, bearer credentials, ANSI, and oversized diagnostics.
- Wide terminals show a compact session/activity rail; narrow terminals prioritize the transcript.
- Header displays busy state, provider/model, thinking level, and session.
- `Ctrl+P` command palette plus `Ctrl+M`, `Ctrl+T`, `Ctrl+N`, and `Ctrl+X`.
- Slash aliases: `/commands`, `/model`, `/thinking`, `/new`, `/abort`, `/shell`.
- Extension input/editor/select dialogs no longer overwrite the learner’s main composer draft.
